blind.description: A stylised medieval-fantasy wooden weapon rack holding an array of hand weapons. The frame consists of two square upright posts with chamfered caps and stabilising feet, connected by top and bottom horizontal crossbars with a planked backboard. Metallic square pyramid studs secure the joints. Mounted vertically inside the rack are three distinct swords (with steel blades, crossguards, pommels, and coloured grips), a battleaxe with a curved double-bearded iron head, and a spiked iron mace/club. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylised hand-painted wood and metal textures with no holes, floating shards, or disconnected parts.
blind.from_above: An elongated rectangular beam structure with two wider post caps at the ends, stabilising feet projecting front and back, and a row of weapon handles, pommels, and heads visible within the slot between the front bar and back panel.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 0.5 to 0.6 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3 to 3.5 ft tall) and slightly wider than its height (about 3.5 to 4 ft wide).

notes: footprint proportion 1.49x off the catalog (5.0 x 1.9 ft)
